change.behavior: Add an 8192-element search ceiling for parameter-cache selection. The baseline wide-row tile remains 4096; the existing UB budget, row-capacity calculation, tile-count limit, and ranking still govern selection.

static_reachability.condition: wide row and resident parameter-cache candidate with sufficient UB budget
static_reachability.example: For width 8193, an 8192-element tile has 2 tiles versus 3 at 4096; the selector may choose it only when the existing budget and ranking permit.
